positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Lower relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Lower relative price than most peers: 9.9% below its local comparables; 19 of 102 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (88.9): 6.4 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 96 of 108 similar developments with a figure. Context, not scored: resales in 100% of months (24 months).

rentalYield.caption: Gross yield = 12 x typical rent / typical resale price for the same size band. Before maintenance, property tax, vacancy and agent fees. Not a return on your cash. Lease: 99 yrs from 2014.

rules.peers: same class, market segment and 100 sq ft size band; original lease 99 years or longer, including freehold and 999-year (short leases excluded)
rules.range: the range from combining the middle half of rents with the middle half of prices (12 x lower-quartile rent / upper-quartile price to 12 x upper-quartile rent / lower-quartile price); not a confidence interval
rules.shortLease: Developments with leases under 99 years are excluded from standard long-lease peer groups.

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.statement: Not available: too few resales by bedroom type for a like-for-like entry-price comparison; the size-matched price position applies.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Hougang MRT about 1,060 m, Kangkar LRT about 1,190 m; closer than 23 of 116 similar developments. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 9 within 2 km; nearest CHIJ Our Lady of the Nativity about 550 m; more than 14 of 116 similar developments (the same as 24). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

nearest.name: CHIJ Our Lady of the Nativity

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 3 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 500 m), more than 27 of 116 similar developments (the same as 26); nearest hawker centre Buangkok Hawker Centre about 1,550 m; nearest park Punggol Park about 400 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: No other condo development sold new homes within 2 km. Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 29 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 0 new sales and 608 resales (608 purchases); new sales were 0% of these purchases. Subsales (40) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 608 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 95 of 116 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 608 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 657 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−7.5%). Planning-area private resales −7.5%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
